description: Six semantic timbre axes. Pure function of these -> concrete params.

body.description: Low-end fullness and resonance. Low = hollow and thin, high = full and solid.
body.title: Body

brightness.description: Spectral brightness. Low = dark and muffled, high = present and cutting.
brightness.title: Brightness

motion.description: Amount of movement over time: LFO rate and depth, plus filter-envelope travel.
motion.title: Motion

size.description: Stereo width and unison detune. High = wide and thick, low = mono and focused.
size.title: Size

title: Macros
